notes: v014 is underdetermined and v015 selected, both resolving to the base; the English matches.
Whereupon is read as a portmanteau under rule 35 rather than as a noncompositional unit under rule 45, since -upon carries the preposition; rule 81 makes a looser gloss of ἐν no objection.
The outer τῆς has no determiner of its own, the ASV writing only of the, which belongs to the inner τῶν under rule 21; the supplied the of the authority stays on the anarthrous ἐξουσίας.
